platform.description: Mirror official immutable vendor images and build only proven compatibility layers.

command:
set -euo pipefail

WAIT_MAX_SECS=300
WAIT_INTERVAL=5
GARAGE_S3_URL="http://${GARAGE_FULLNAME}.${POD_NAMESPACE}.svc.cluster.local:3900/"
# GARAGE_ADMIN_URL is injected as an env var by the Helm template pointing
# to the <fullname>-admin ClusterIP Service on port 3903. A
# dedicated service is required because the upstream StatefulSet headless
# service only exposes ports 3900/3902; Istio drops connections to
# unregistered ports under outboundTrafficPolicy: REGISTRY_ONLY.

# Invoke the Garage v2 admin REST API with bearer token authentication.
admin() {
  local method="$1" path="$2"; shift 2
  local args=(-sf -X "${method}" "${GARAGE_ADMIN_URL}/${path}" -H "Content-Type: application/json")
  [ -n "${GARAGE_ADMIN_TOKEN:-}" ] && args+=(-H "Authorization: Bearer ${GARAGE_ADMIN_TOKEN}")
  curl "${args[@]}" "$@"
}

# 1. Wait for the Garage S3 API to become reachable.
# A healthy Garage returns HTTP 403 (AccessDenied XML) for unsigned requests.
echo "==> [1/3] Waiting for Garage S3 API at ${GARAGE_S3_URL} (timeout ${WAIT_MAX_SECS}s)..."
wait_start=$(date +%s)
while true; do
  http_code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "${GARAGE_S3_URL}" 2>/dev/null || echo "000")
  if [ "${http_code}" != "000" ]; then
    echo "  Garage S3 API reachable (HTTP ${http_code})."
    break
  fi
  waited=$(( $(date +%s) - wait_start ))
  if [ "${waited}" -ge "${WAIT_MAX_SECS}" ]; then
    echo "  ERROR: Timed out after ${waited}s waiting for Garage S3 API."
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "  Garage S3 API not yet reachable; retrying in ${WAIT_INTERVAL}s..."
  sleep "${WAIT_INTERVAL}"
done

# 1b. Wait for all expected nodes to appear in the cluster.
# The S3 API responds immediately on pod start (before cluster formation);
# layout apply requires all nodes to be visible or it silently drops nodes.
echo "==> [1b] Waiting for ${GARAGE_EXPECTED_NODES} nodes via admin API (timeout ${WAIT_MAX_SECS}s)..."
wait_start=$(date +%s)
while true; do
  status_json=$(admin GET v2/GetClusterStatus 2>/dev/null || echo '{}')
  node_count=$(echo "${status_json}" | jq -r '(.nodes // []) | length')
  if [ "${node_count}" -ge "${GARAGE_EXPECTED_NODES}" ]; then
    echo "  ${node_count}/${GARAGE_EXPECTED_NODES} nodes visible."
    break
  fi
  waited=$(( $(date +%s) - wait_start ))
  if [ "${waited}" -ge "${WAIT_MAX_SECS}" ]; then
    echo "  ERROR: Timed out after ${waited}s waiting for ${GARAGE_EXPECTED_NODES} Garage nodes."
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "  ${node_count}/${GARAGE_EXPECTED_NODES} nodes visible; retrying in ${WAIT_INTERVAL}s..."
  sleep "${WAIT_INTERVAL}"
done

# 2. Bootstrap cluster layout if at version 0.
echo "==> [2/3] Checking cluster layout..."
layout_json=$(admin GET v2/GetClusterLayout)
layout_ver=$(echo "${layout_json}" | jq -r '.version // 0')
if [ "${layout_ver}" = "0" ]; then
  echo "  Layout version 0; bootstrapping zone=${GARAGE_ZONE} capacity=${GARAGE_CAPACITY_BYTES}..."
  status_json=$(admin GET v2/GetClusterStatus)
  assign_payload=$(echo "${status_json}" | jq -c \
    --arg zone "${GARAGE_ZONE}" \
    --argjson cap "${GARAGE_CAPACITY_BYTES}" \
    '{roles: [.nodes[] | {id: .id, zone: $zone, capacity: $cap, tags: []}]}')
  node_count_in_payload=$(echo "${assign_payload}" | jq -r '.roles | length')
  if [ "${node_count_in_payload}" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "  ERROR: No nodes found in GetClusterStatus. Raw response:"
    echo "  ${status_json}"
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "  Staging ${node_count_in_payload} node(s)..."
  admin POST v2/UpdateClusterLayout -d "${assign_payload}" >/dev/null
  admin POST v2/ApplyClusterLayout -d '{"version":1}' >/dev/null
  echo "  Layout bootstrapped."
else
  echo "  Layout already at version ${layout_ver}; skipping."
fi

# 3. Provision each consumer: import access key and configure buckets.
# Uses bash indirect expansion (${!var}) to read indexed env vars at runtime.
# ImportKey is idempotent: returns 200 on first install, 409 if the key ID
# already exists. On 409 the stored secretAccessKey is verified against the
# credentials Secret - a mismatch means the key was rotated out-of-band and
# consumers will receive 403. See docs/credential-rotation.md.
echo "==> [3/3] Provisioning ${CONSUMER_COUNT} consumer(s)..."
for i in $(seq 0 $((CONSUMER_COUNT - 1))); do
  name_var="CONSUMER_${i}_NAME"
  key_var="CONSUMER_${i}_ACCESS_KEY_ID"
  secret_var="CONSUMER_${i}_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"
  buckets_var="CONSUMER_${i}_BUCKETS"

  consumer_name="${!name_var}"
  access_key_id="${!key_var}"
  secret_access_key="${!secret_var}"
  consumer_buckets="${!buckets_var}"

  echo "  [consumer: ${consumer_name}] Syncing access key ${access_key_id:0:10}..."
  import_http="000"
  wait_start=$(date +%s)
  while true; do
    import_http=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' \
      -X POST "${GARAGE_ADMIN_URL}/v2/ImportKey" \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer ${GARAGE_ADMIN_TOKEN}" \
      -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
      -d "{\"accessKeyId\":\"${access_key_id}\",\"secretAccessKey\":\"${secret_access_key}\",\"name\":\"${consumer_name}\"}") || true
    if [ "${import_http}" = "200" ] || [ "${import_http}" = "409" ]; then
      break
    fi
    waited=$(( $(date +%s) - wait_start ))
    if [ "${waited}" -ge "${WAIT_MAX_SECS}" ]; then
      echo "  ERROR: ImportKey for '${consumer_name}' returned HTTP ${import_http:-000} after ${waited}s"
      exit 1
    fi
    echo "  ImportKey returned HTTP ${import_http:-000}; retrying in ${WAIT_INTERVAL}s..."
    sleep "${WAIT_INTERVAL}"
  done
  if [ "${import_http}" = "409" ]; then
    echo "  Key exists; verifying stored secret for '${consumer_name}'..."
    key_info=$(admin GET "v2/GetKeyInfo?id=${access_key_id}&showSecretKey=true" \
      2>/dev/null || echo '{}')
    stored_secret=$(echo "${key_info}" | jq -r '.secretAccessKey // empty')
    if [ -z "${stored_secret}" ]; then
      echo "  ERROR: Could not retrieve secretAccessKey for '${consumer_name}'."
      echo "  Verify GARAGE_ADMIN_TOKEN is correct."
      exit 1
    fi
    if [ "${stored_secret}" != "${secret_access_key}" ]; then
      echo "  ERROR: Secret mismatch for '${consumer_name}' - Garage holds a"
      echo "  different secretAccessKey than the credentials Secret. Consumers will receive 403."
      echo "  To rotate S3 credentials safely, follow docs/credential-rotation.md."
      exit 1
    fi
    echo "  Stored secret verified for '${consumer_name}'."
  fi
  echo "  Key ${access_key_id:0:10}... ready for '${consumer_name}' (HTTP ${import_http})."

  echo "  [consumer: ${consumer_name}] Configuring buckets..."
  for bucket in ${consumer_buckets}; do
    [ -n "${bucket}" ] || continue
    echo "    Processing bucket '${bucket}'..."
    create_http=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' \
      -X POST "${GARAGE_ADMIN_URL}/v2/CreateBucket" \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer ${GARAGE_ADMIN_TOKEN}" \
      -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
      -d "{\"globalAlias\":\"${bucket}\"}" || echo "000")
    if [ "${create_http}" != "200" ] && [ "${create_http}" != "409" ]; then
      echo "    ERROR: CreateBucket returned HTTP ${create_http} for '${bucket}'. Garage may not be ready; retry the upgrade."
      exit 1
    fi
    bucket_info=$(admin GET "v2/GetBucketInfo?globalAlias=${bucket}")
    bucket_id=$(echo "${bucket_info}" | jq -r '.id // empty')
    if [ -z "${bucket_id}" ]; then
      echo "    ERROR: Could not determine bucket ID for '${bucket}'. Response: ${bucket_info}"
      exit 1
    fi
    admin POST v2/AllowBucketKey \
      -d "{\"bucketId\":\"${bucket_id}\",\"accessKeyId\":\"${access_key_id}\",\"permissions\":{\"read\":true,\"write\":true,\"owner\":true}}" >/dev/null
    echo "    Bucket '${bucket}' ready for '${consumer_name}' (id=${bucket_id})."
  done
done

echo "==> Garage initialization complete."

curl -fsI -X POST http://localhost:15020/quitquitquit || true
